start: You wake on a bed of hay as a wagon rattles toward Oakhaven. Today is the town fair and the Adventurers’ Guild is taking on recruits. In your pocket are two coins and a letter for {boss}.
Jump from the moving wagon to take a shortcut through the bushes.
Ask the driver where a newcomer should go first.
Ride to the gates and step out onto the town square.
The bushes hide a steep ravine. You tumble through the brambles and land hard.
The driver points you toward the fountain. From there, both the guild and the tavern are an easy walk.
The wagon eases to a stop at the carved gates. You step into the morning bustle.
crossroads: Water splashes into a stone fountain in the middle of Oakhaven. The Golden Acorn tavern stands to your left, the guildhall is straight ahead, and bright market stalls crowd the street to your right.
Turn left for the Golden Acorn and the latest news.
Head straight to the guild’s job board.
Wander through the fair on your right.
You push open the oak door and step into the cool tavern.
You climb the wide steps into the bright guildhall.
You slip between stalls selling oddities and fresh pastries.
tavern: The tavern smells of bread and baked apples. Marta polishes mugs at the counter. A ranger studies a map by the fire while a bruiser argues with some mercenaries.
Ask the ranger what’s worth seeing nearby.
Ask Marta if she needs an errand run.
Kick the bruiser’s chair and challenge his entire table.
The ranger tells you about a talking cat at the wizard’s tower and gives you his map.
Marta sends you to the fair with a parcel of spices and a warm apple pie.
Three bouncers toss you through the window and onto a stack of barrels.
guild: Recruits crowd around the maps while {boss} sorts the morning reports. The clerk at the counter looks up, ready to find you an assignment.
Ask the clerk for a first assignment.
Check the wall map for the river crossing.
Grab a practice staff and strike it against the floor.
The clerk sends you to Cornelius’s tower. The wizard could use a steady pair of hands.
You memorize the route and follow a leafy path out of town.
A practice lightning bolt bursts in your hands. Half the hall rushes to put out your cloak.
market: At the fair, a herbalist lays out fragrant bundles and a clockmaker repairs pocket compasses. A sign points toward the Green Grove.
Ask the herbalist about plants in the valley.
Ask the clockmaker for directions to the old windmill.
Gulp down the alchemist’s bubbling blue potion.
The herbalist hands you a pocket guide and recommends the Green Grove.
The clockmaker points across the river and gives you a repaired brass compass.
That was concentrated horseshoe glue. Your stomach twists and the square spins.
wizard_tower: A plump ginger cat in a tiny wizard’s hat lounges on the tower steps. Cornelius whistles a tune through the open window.
Greet the cat and ask permission to enter.
Ask Cornelius for directions to the ferry.
Pull the cat’s tail and charge the tower door.
The cat straightens its hat. “Welcome,” it says, rolling an amulet to your feet.
Cornelius points to a riverside path and tosses you a flask of apple tonic.
A ward flashes. You sail across the yard into a thorny gooseberry bush.
woods: A birchwood path forks beside a musician with a lute. A wooden sign points one way to the ferry and the other to Warm Crag.
Ask the musician which path to take.
Follow the lower path toward the ferry.
Climb a dead tree above the drop to reach a wild hive.
The musician strums a bright chord and recommends the view from Warm Crag.
The leaves rustle overhead. Soon you hear running water.
The branch cracks. You drop straight into a swarm of furious hornets.
river_ferry: Sunlight glints on the wide river. A ferryman readies his boat at the dock. A stone bridge leads toward the white pillars of the old observatory.
Take the ferry toward the windmill.
Cross the stone bridge to the observatory.
Leap from the pier toward the spinning waterwheel.
The ferryman welcomes you aboard and rows you across the quiet inlet.
You cross the bridge and reach a garden of pale columns.
The current pulls you under the wheel. The ferryman fishes you out just in time.
windmill: Clover and fresh flour scent the air around the windmill. The miller laughs from a bench. Raccoons have stolen his keys and carried them into the garden.
Trade the raccoons a crust of bread for the keys.
Ask the miller for the trail to Warm Crag.
Grab one of the windmill’s spinning sails.
The raccoons take the bread. For returning his keys, the miller gives you a silver charm.
The miller points across a meadow toward the foothills.
The sail lifts you high into the air and flings you into prickly thistles.
ruins: Flowers grow around the white pillars of the Elven Observatory. A scholar sketches a sundial on a bench where two garden paths meet.
Ask the scholar how the old sundial works.
Follow the garden path toward the travelers’ camp.
Kick the heavy stone column at the edge of the terrace.
She shows you how to turn the pointer. A sun lens drops from a hidden compartment.
The path slopes down to a clearing where campfire smoke rises.
A ledge breaks loose and a chunk of stone lands on your head.
dragon_hill: Aurelia, a golden dragon in reading glasses, leafs through fairy tales atop Warm Crag. Mountain tea steams beside her, close to the sign for the valley.
Greet Aurelia and ask about her book.
Enjoy the view, then descend toward camp.
Snatch the dragon’s book and shout in her ear.
Aurelia pours you tea with honey and gives you a golden scale to remember her by.
You breathe in the mountain air and follow the trail down.
Aurelia sneezes a cloud of flame. You roll down the hill with smoking eyebrows.
camp: Travelers and merchants sit around a fire beside the stream. Stew bubbles in a pot. A broad road leads back to Oakhaven.
Sit by the fire, share stories, and rest.
Ask a merchant for the road back to the square.
Jump into the campfire to impress the travelers.
A hot meal and good company restore your strength.
You walk with the caravan and return to the town fountain.
Your boots catch fire. A bucket of cold water saves them, but the burns sting.
alley: In a sunny alley behind the bakery, a guard feeds crumbs to pigeons. The main square is just around the corner.
Ask the guard for the quickest route to the guildhall.
Walk back to the fountain in the main square.
Try to take the guard’s helmet and halberd.
The guard shows you an archway leading straight to the guild doors.
A moment later, you are back in the heart of Oakhaven.
The guard sweeps your feet from under you and sends you sprawling on the cobbles.
